intelligence.simple_view: Sweetheart, when lots of us write in the big book at once, I make sure nothing gets lost and nothing gets written twice. And if something goes wrong, I tell you once — not ten times.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, a good bookkeeper writes everything down once, love, and in the right order — even when ten hands are writing at once. And she only rings the bell once per problem, dear, or nobody listens when it really matters.
intelligence.naya_view: I am Anaya. I keep shared memory correct under retries, concurrent work, and waste. I guard the append and the rewrite, I dedupe the alert, and I diagnose the repeat failure before adding capacity. One verified record per event.
